dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: Hmm, not now. I just passed a camp of the Eremites, and he was not there. Maybe he went to the hotel looking for me for a drink.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: To be honest, most Sumeru people like to drink, but I'm not used to alcohol. I would feel dizzy after just half a glass.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: But it'd be a lack of decorum to refuse an Eremite. He often comes to invite me for a drink, and I should care about his feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: I'll just stay out of his sight for now.
